notes.title: Join the articy:draft Unity plugin beta
notes.content:
On our website we already posted that we're working on an [b]articy:draft [url=http://www.nevigo.com/en/fast-track-into-unity/]integration for Unity[/url][/b] and something called the [b][url=http://www.nevigo.com/en/feature-in-development-articydraft-internal-api-video/]Macro Devkit.[/url][/b]

In short the Macro Devkit allows you [b]to develop your own customized plug-ins[/b] and helps to [b]integrate articy:draft in your individual workflow[/b].

And right now, we’re running a beta to test and improve these new features. [b]This is your chance to play an active part in the development of articy:draft.[/b]

[h1]WE INVITE YOU TO TEST THE UNITY PLUGIN & MACRO DEVKIT AS BETA PARTNER![/h1]

All you have to do is to write us an email to [b]beta@nevigo.com[/b] and tell us why you want to test the software and what you plan to do with it. If you qualify as a beta partner we’ll contact you with further instructions on how you can test these new features.

[b]IMPORTANT INFO: This will be a feature of the upcoming articy:draft version 3.0![/b]

notes.title: Update 2.4 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.steampowered.com/v/gfx/apps/230780/extras/Articy_Release_SteamWhite.png[/img]

Update 2.4 is the biggest free feature update for articy:draft 2 so far. It does not only contain the much-anticipated [b]simulation mode[/b], it also brings a whole bunch of major [b]location editor improvements[/b].

On top of that we also implemented feature requests from the community like the possibility to clone single-user projects and support for floating multi-user licenses. Besides many other bug fixes version 2.4 also improves the performance for editing text – providing you with a much smoother writing experience.

Watch the [url=http://www.nevigo.com/redirect/?release2.4whatsnew] video[/url] or read about it on our [url=http://www.nevigo.com/en/articydraft/whatsnew/] Website[/url].

notes.title: 2.3 BETA Available Now
notes.content:
[img]http://www.nevigo.com/_notification_images/2_3/Beta2_3_small.jpg[/img]

In the last weeks we’ve worked hard to improve the overall performance of articy:draft, especially for those of you working with very large projects (> 100k objects). We know that some of you can’t wait to feel the impact of these improvements, so we decided to make them available as soon as possible. If you want to test the upcoming version 2.3, you are very welcome to install the just released 2.3 BETA build. 

[h1][url=http://www.nevigo.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=10&t=1676]You find all information on how to get the beta client and how to report bugs in our forums[/url].[/h1]

Besides performance improvements and minor fixes the 2.3 update also contains some new features:
[list][*]Flow to Word export: You can now export all your branching flow structures into an easily readable .docx-file, which you can e.g. use for voice-over recordings. 
[*].XPS export: You can now export your flows and locations to .xps (a vector graphic format), so you can send your visual designs to others more conveniently or print them and decorate your office walls  
[*]Better usability for editing templates: Get from the property sheet of an object to the template editor with just a single click. [/list]
[url=http://www.nevigo.com/help/index.php?product=articydraft&page=Changes_2_3&lang=en]Click here[/url] to see a more detailed overview of the recent changes.

But please keep in mind: [b]This is a beta version[/b] and it’s likely that you find a bug or two. So, thanks a lot to everybody who is helping us to hunt them down!

notes.title: articy:draft 2 SE | Version 2.2 released
notes.content:
This announcement informs you about the most important changes and improvements introduced by version articy:draft 2 SE version 2.2. ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/230791/][b]articy:draft SE - Upgrade to articy:draft 2 SE DLC required[/b][/url])

You can also find a detailed change list [url=http://www.nevigo.com/help/index.php?product=articydraft&lang=en&page=RecentChanges]here[/url].

[h1][b]New![/b] "Conditional flow logic"[/h1]

The most significant set of improvements concern modeling logic in the Flow using variables, conditions and instructions.

[b]Global Variables[/b]
In a new area in the project structure called “Global Variables” you can create variable sets (i.e. “Quest Variables”) and fill them with variables, sometimes called “flags”. Variables can be Boolean (true / false) or Integer numbers.

You can use those variables in condition scripts or assignments.

[b]New flow nodes: Conditions / Instructions[/b]
To use conditional branching points or pieces of script code in the Flow, you can add these two new node types. The text fields for conditions and instructions support syntax highlighting and auto-completion.

[i]Make sure to switch this on in the Flow-settings for migrated projects.[/i]

[b]Conditions and instructions as property types in templates[/b]
A new “script” property type allows you to use text fields for scripting (with syntax highlighting and auto-completion) in your templates.

[b]Circular node connections[/b]
You can now connect a node’s output pins with its input pins to create loops.
